'''David Akers Bespin and Beyond Tip and Tricks''' is a strategy article [[David Akers]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The Information Broker collected a series of Akers tips into one page and numbered them Tip #1 through Tip #5.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Bespinandbeyondtips.htm Bespin and Beyond: Tip and Tricks], The Outer Rim (David Akers). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234948/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Bespinandbeyondtips.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

Title: Bespin and Beyond: Tip
and Tricks


Note from the Infomation Broker:
David did these tips and tricks in a series of articles. I have put them all
together for you in one article. I labeled them Tip #1 and so forth, so you
can know when David started other articles. Thanks and Enjoy..and a Very much
Thank you to David Akers.


Tip #1


Crazy Sabacc:


I call this strategy crazy because its sabacc taken to the nth degree. Basically
either side gets down

Lando (with vaders cape and mandelorian armor) at the CC: Casino with some protection
and plays sabacc.

"That�s not so bad" -misinformed swccg player


The real problem emerges when you realize that Lando:


A. Almost always wins

B. Retrieves 3 force each time he wins

C. Can play Trooper Sabacc as well as Cloud City Sabacc on each players turn


So what we have is the potential to Play 2 sabaccs per each players

turn retrieve 12 force and cause the opponent to loose 4 (+1 for the drain)
force.

Ask yourself can your deck withstand this barrage of force retrieval and force
loss?

If so then you will be ok. If not take this Hint:

The opponent can not play sabacc if you do not have two force in your reserve
deck.

Simply set up a few drains and then activate all your force.

Your opponent will curse and scream as you slowly dwindle away their life force.

But hey its their fault for playing a non interactive deck anyway.

Hope this helps.


Tip #2


Operatives:


Starting with the Operative Objective is bound to be popular for both

sides. Dark has Nal Hutta and the Light has Bothuwui. Now I played

these decks before so I know they can come out fast and while a drain

of 5 on turn 2 or 3 won�t make PB3 jealous they can be deadly in a B&B

environment. Now I�m partial to the operatives in this scenario environment
so I�m going to give you hints how a dark operatives can

beat light and visa versa.


Dark Ops vs. Light Ops.


To stop their drains try one of the following.

A. Imperial Decree with Kuat and Wakeelmui

B. Coruscant and A Bright Center to the Universe

C. Convert their forest and deploy Quarren/Imperial trooper

Guard Daison/DLOTS and cancel drains at three locations

D. Den of thieves (you should probably start with this)


To battle them effectively try.

A. Converting their locations such as the swamp or forest.

If the opponent was under the impression they could react there you will

catch them totally of guard. Also you can then deploy bubo there from

the reserve. At the forest the two destinies isn�t so bad if all your

characters are immune to attrition (especial EPP Vader)

B. Disrupter Pistols aimed at an operative will almost guarantee he is

out the battle before he can draw destiny.


To out drain them try.

A. Clouds on Nal Huta with gas miners even if you only have one of

each in play it adds 3 to your drains.

B. Your not likely going to win against Light side operatives if you

don�t try the other methods above.


To Gain Force Advantage try.

A. Play Projective Telepathy

B. Play Projective Telepathy

C. Deploy Wakeelmui and Kuat and Coruscant


To shut down thier retrieval try. A. Secret Plans

B. Surprise their Narshadda Wind chimes (unless they are playing Goo Nee Tay)


Light Side Ops vs Dark side Ops.


To stop their drains try.

A. Hark Seff

B. A Gift

C. A Gift


To battle them effectively try.

C. Play Sandspeeders start with Maneuvering flaps or play Cloud Cars

and ASP Droids. Deploy a droid and slam them with a few vehicles.

This is probably the best strategy for battling them (sorry EPP�s).

I�ll take a power 5 forfeit 6 Sandspeeder that deploys for 1 over them any day.

Seriously these vehicles will win you the game in this scenario.

Cloud cars might be better they sure are easier to come by. I even

have all the EPP�s *3, vehicles are just better if you�re playing Ops/ASP�s.

D. Frozen Assets/Draw their Fire to shut down any reacting or interupts they
rely on.


To out drain them try.

A. Ithorians

B. Clouds/Miners

C. Coruscant and Kiffex


Here�s a quiz questions how can the light side get a drain of five

from each site (forest,jungle,swamp) in the B&B scenario? It can be done.


Overall I think Light has the advantage over Dark, so if your playing

dark side ops your going to have to put a few curve balls in your strategy

to stop them. Most notably put in protection from A Gift and you should be OK.


If you were putting together an Operative deck I hope this helped.

Don't forget to look for more post in this series.


Tip #3


The Bewil Gambit


The Trick:

A typical scenario for running the Bewil Gambit is like this.

Dark has Upper Plaza Corridor, Carbonite Chamber, and Security tower

on the table with Vader at the Carbon Chamber and Lando and Lobot at

the Security Tower, and only 2 cloud city troopers at the Upper Plaza Corridor.


Put down Melas and EPP Lea to wipe out the troopers right?

So you wipe out the troopers but decide to stick around the corridor I

mean it�s a force drain +1 and if you move over you will have to face Vader.


Next turn dark deploys Capt Bewil to the upper plaza corridor with

EPP Bobafett and then moves Vader, Lando and Lobot over to the corridor

ala the corridor game text for free.

Now your in a mess because you can�t even move away and if you don�t

have any more troops to send in your going to get hit hard. Vader will

probably YAB Lea and then swing at Melas.

The great thing about this strategic move is that it works even if you

have already deployed Bewil to another site. Just move with the Corridor�s game
text and the light is locked in.


And as if that wasn�t enough Bewil can reposition your support troops

to the other end of Cloud City by taking into hand Heart of the Chasm.

Obi-wan and Luke won�t due you much good if Bewil moves them three sites away.

They might eventually get to the party but it will be over by then.


The Tip:

A: Well look for this coming, being aware will certainly help you to avoid this
deadly trap.

B: Also try converting the Upper Corridor. Then you will be able to at

least move your support troops in or prevent the dark from amassing their troops.

C: If you do get caught by this, initiate a losing battle before the

opponent can play any interrupts like YAB or gets another deploy phase

to reinforce this way you minimize your losses.

D. Stay off Cloud City or at least the UC (Bewil ability gives the

Dark Side the edge here)


Thanks to those people who gave me positive feedback about my last Tips and
Tricks. Hope this one helps you too.


Tip #4


Behold I present to you �A Gift�


The Trick:

Giving your opponent �A Gift� will go along way towards ensuring your

victory. To do it right you will need at least one (two if you�re serious)

of the following: LS Audience Chamber, Entrance Cavern, Artoo and A Gift.


A Gift pretty much helps out any B&B light side deck I can think of.

Unfortunately unless you�re playing an all tatooine drainer (not a bad

idea with Tessek and Bo Shuda) the sights aren�t all that helpful.

Its up to you how many cards to dedicate to this defense block.

The minimun I would use is 1 droid and 1 �A Gift�. Unfortunately there

really is no way the light side can protect the droid in this scenario

other than surrounding it with EPPs. Return to Sender


The Tip:


Hey, unless your not playing aliens you got to deal with �A gift�.

First, unless you need to go to Jabba�s palace don�t. By not giving

the Light side any pieces of their �A gift� (locations) combo then you

make it much harder for them to use it.


Second, getting a 4-card combo together (a gift) is hard enough without having
to

deal with fast drains. Try to get some fast drains and maybe get

rid of one of those key components.

Once you have been �A gifted� don�t despair, you still have a few options.

1. Any warrior + Hut Smooch.

You need somebody there to capture the spy right. Some interesting

choices would be Vader with Lightsaber (less risky), Chief Retwin(more risky
because of FA)

or if they are playing Bo Shuda any alien warrior.

2. Trooper + Blasted Droid + Blaster

This isn�t entirely useless, but 3 cards need to come together, which

makes it much harder to do. Pros: You can use this even if they aren�t

playing AG. Cons: You got to wait to your control phase so you might

have to send a few attrition fodder troops in as well.

3. Warrior + Hut Smooch + Ev99 + Droid Workshop + Torture

Hey if the guy falls for it you might retrieve a bunch of force.

Pros: If you playing None Shall Pass deck you should have most of these cards
already.

Cons: More cards in the combo.

4. Jawa + Tattoine site + Dune Sea Sabacc

This probably isn�t worth mentioning but hey if you steal their droid

I guess you prevented �A gift�. Pros: none. Cons: almost guaranteed

not to work, and no pros.


Hey, I consider myself a decent player, and I�ll be playing �A gift� think about
how you would stop me.


Tip #5


Dark Deal


The Trick:

Dark Deal is a massive way to increase your force drains at Cloud.

In fact I thought that it was so good I played with pretty good success

at last years regional. The trick to my Dark Deal deck was getting out

3 sites with cheap deploying characters and deploying the DD all at once.

I played 4 Imperial Supplies Tactical Support and 6 Dark Deals and about 12
CC sites.

There was a problem though I found that if I had to fight to control Bespin:
CC I was slowed down considerably.

So I upped my cloud cars, and ties too about 12 card slots. I started

with Bespin: CC and was able to control it easily. I could usually get DD out
on turn 2 or 3.


The same tactics apply and are even enhanced in the B&B enviroment.

Without the need too worry about Grimtash you can pick up as many cards as you
want without fear.

Enhanced starfighters and cloud cars combined with the absent of some rather
important Light side nemisis

(Falcon, RL, GL) make it even more tempting. If your planing on running Dark
Deal look at the

counter strategies below and see if you can incorporate some counters to them
in your deck.


Re-Deal


Tip:

There are some things you can do to counter Dark Deal here are just a few:

To Prevent Dark Deal try:

1. Occupy Bespin Cloud City � as long as you occupy it they can�t get

Dark Deal off. Of course that means you need to be using starships or vehicles.

My preference is cloud cars with maneuvering flaps.

2. Control Bespin � If you playing Hidden Base and the other guy starts with
BCC pull out your Bespin and occupy it.

It adds to his deploy and might slow him down long enough for you to control
BCC.


3.Try to control ground locations. If your opponent starts putting

down CC sites because they don�t have enough force. Exploit that weakness.

Warning: don�t forget about tip #3 the Bewil Gambit. A wise opponent won�t put
any locations down before he can get DD off so you

might not be able to do this anyway.


To cancel Dark Deal try:

1. Surreptitious Glance � it�s a card that cancels Dark Deal. If he is

playing 4 or 5 DD though this won�t help much. But hey if your playing

Lobot and Lando it has other uses. 2. Occupying Locations � Well if he isn�t
playing aqualishes then its

not hard, just watch out for Bewil. Or you can occupy Bespin the system,

Bespin: Cloud City and two generic cloud sectors to cancel it.

3. Play operatives and �A gift� yeah its a lot of cards, but if you

can get it off fast enough you�ll win.

4. Battle, normally to sacrifice for speed the dark side gives up

a lot of its battle potential. Just battle if this is the case. Don�t forget
to

add 4 to the power of that lone CC trooper (+2 if you think he is playing Trooper
Assault) and one for every Car or Tie at BCC.

This can easily be 12 or more power from a single Trooper so watch out when

you deploy there and pick your battles wisely.

Your going to see Dark Deal so, just keep your cool and try some of

the above strategies and you just might come out ahead.


Well thats it from David. Also Note that David KNOWS that you can not retreive
with Trooper Sabacc only Cloud City Sabacc. There might be other minor mistakes
so let us know thanks for reading


David
Akers
